answer: The zenith schedule is applied in tide and ferrous makes public each instalment. Anyone thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split and as a result 59% arrives at settlement and the rest over 20 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4946 identities would post 2787 proofs and burn roughly 23 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
